headline: Paraguay Central Bank Intervenes in Ueno Bank Amid Capital Shortfall
summary: The Central Bank of Paraguay has intervened in digital lender Ueno Bank due to severe capital insufficiency. Following the move, opposition lawmakers have filed an impeachment request against President Santiago Peña.
why: Ueno Bank is a significant digital financial institution in Paraguay. Bank failures and political instability can lead to currency volatility and reduced investor confidence in emerging market banking sectors.

impacts.name: Ueno Bank
impacts.why: The bank is under regulatory intervention due to capital insolvency.
